spans.s:
वञ्च् वञ्च् (probably connected with rt.
वङ्क्), cl. 1. P. वञ्चति, ववञ्च, Prec.
वच्यात्, वञ्चितुम्, to move to and fro, shake,
vibrate, tremble, totter, rock about, waver (Ved.);
to go crookedly; to go slyly or secretly, sneak along;
to go, go to, arrive at; to pass over, wander over,
go astray: Pass. वच्यते, Ved. to move or rock to
and fro, roll, hurry along, (but according to Sāy. on
Ṛg-veda

. वच्यन्ते = उच्यन्ते, as if fr. rt.
वच्, to speak, proclaim, address, &c.): Caus. P.
वञ्चयति, &c., to move or go away from,
avoid, escape, shun, evade (generally P. and with
acc.): Caus. A. वञ्चयते, &c., to cause to go
astray, deceive, defraud, delude, trick, cheat, (in these
senses properly A., but sometimes also P.): Pass. of
Caus. वञ्च्यते, to be deceived: Desid. विवञ्चि-
षते: Intens. वनीवच्यते, वनीवञ्चीति; [cf. pro-
bably Gr. ἄτη, ἀτάω, ἀπάτη, ἀτάσθαλος, ἀτύξομαι;
Lat. vafer.]

वञ्चक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus.), deceiving,
cheating, one who deceives, a deceiver, rogue, cheat,
knave; fraudulent, deceitful, crafty; (अस्), m. a
jackal; a musk-rat; a tame or house-ichneumon.

वञ्चथ, अस्, m. a deceiver, rogue, knave, cheat;
the Indian cuckoo; cheating.

वञ्चन, अम्, आ, n. f. (fr. the Caus.), the act of
deceiving, cheating, defrauding, fraud, deceit, (वञ्-
चनम् or वञ्चनां कृ, to practise fraud, cheat);
illusion, delusion, hallucination.
—वञ्चन-ता, f.
trickery, deception, roguishness.
—वञ्चन-प्र-
वण, अस्, आ, अम्, inclined to fraud or deception.
—वञ्चन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, deceitful, crafty, fraudu-
lent.

वञ्चनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be avoided or shunned;
to be deceived, capable of being cheated.
वञ्चयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be tricked or cheated.

वञ्चयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who deceives, a
deceiver, cheat.

वञ्चयित्वा, ind. having cheated or deceived,
having deluded.

वञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), deceived,
tricked, cheated, deluded, imposed upon; (आ), f. a
kind of riddle or enigma.
वञ्चितक in पक्ष-व्˚, q. v.
वञ्चित्वा, ind. having cheated or deceived, &c.

वञ्चिन्, ई, इनी, इ, deceiving, cheating (at the end
of a comp.).

वञ्चुक or वञ्चूक, अस्, ई, अम्, deceptive, fraudu-
lent, dishonest, crafty.

वञ्च्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone, to be avoided,
&c.; to be cheated.
वञ्चति वञ्चति, इस्, m. fire; [cf. अञ्चति.]
वञ्जरा वञ्जरा, f., N. of a river.

वञ्जुल वञ्जुल, अस्, m. the tree Dalbergia
Ougeinensis; another tree, Jonesia Aśoka; common
cane or ratan, Calamus Rotang; a kind of flower,
Hibiscus Mutabilis; a sort of bird; (आ), f. a cow
that yields abundance of milk; N. of a river.
—वञ्-
[]
जुल-द्रुम, अस्, m. the Aśoka tree.
—वञ्जुल-
प्रिय, अस्, m. the ratan, Calamus Rotang.
वञ्जुलक, अस्, m. a kind of plant; a sort of bird.

वाञ्छ् वाञ्छ् [cf. rt. वाङ्क्ष्], cl. 1. P.
(sometimes also A.) वाञ्छति (-ते),
ववाञ्छ, अवाञ्छीत्, वाञ्छितुम्, to desire, wish;
to wish for, ask for, seek after, pursue: Pass. वाञ्छ्-
यते, Aor. अवाञ्छि, to be wished, &c.: Caus. वाञ्-
छयति, -ते, Aor. अववाञ्छत्, to cause to wish,
&c.; [cf. Old Germ. wunsc, ‘wish;’ wunskian,
‘to wish;’ Angl. Sax. wiscan: Eng. wish.]

वाञ्छक, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing, desiring; a wisher,
&c.
वाञ्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing, desiring.
वाञ्छन, अम्, n. the act of desiring, wishing.
वाञ्छनीय, to be wished for, desirable.

वाञ्छा, f. wish, desire; desire for (with loc.,
Kirāt.
IV. 25

वाञ्छित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished, desired, longed for;
wishing, desiring; (अम्), n. wish, desire.

वाञ्छितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be wished or desired,
desirable, &c.
वाञ्छित्वा, ind. having wished, having desired.

वाञ्छिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wishing, desirous; lustful; (इनी),
f. a libidinous woman; a wanton.
वाञ्छ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = वाञ्छनीय, p. 901, col. 3.

वाञ्छ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being wished or de-
sired.
